collections.title: Early Career Correspondence
collections.description: Responses and introductions connected with Robert Cushman’s early efforts to find theatre-criticism work. These documents are presented as a standalone archival series rather than being attached to any one article.

collections.title: Farewell to The Observer
collections.date_label: Departure period, with one undated note
collections.description: Notes sent to Robert Cushman around the end of his regular tenure as The Observer’s theatre critic. They are grouped here with the farewell material preserved on The Observer publication page.

media.alt: Handwritten farewell letter from Simon Gray to Robert Cushman, dated 4 December with no year written

media.caption: Ken Hoare — 8 January 1984
